subject: Spend-tier sanity check & procurement gate — Atlas Logistics
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@atlaslogistics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:20:00 -0500
Subject: Recap + request: spend band confirmation and procurement thresholds

Alex — thanks for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and a clear next step for procurement:  

- Estimated steady-state consumption: ~50M tokens/month (ML inference for routing + summarization).
- Current constraint: finance requires any single SaaS PO >= $25k/month go through an extended review. Smaller monthly payments are easier to approve.
- Goal: lock a predictable $/1M token rate for a committed band so Atlas can forecast costs and avoid surprise spikes.

Questions for you (can you confirm inline?):
1) Is 50M tokens/month the right ballpark for Q2 (yes/no + +/- %)?
2) Does your procurement team require a minimum contract value (monthly or annual) to issue a PO? If so, what threshold triggers extra approvals?
3) Are you open to a short commit (3 months) with the option to escalate to reserved capacity if usage grows?

What we propose next: I attached a short spreadsheet (redwood-pricing-scenarios.xlsx) that maps three commit bands to target $/1M token economics and estimated monthly cost. If you can confirm the procurement threshold and the ballpark token volume, we’ll surface a draft MA/quote for your procurement team and flag the internal discounting/credit path if needed.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet — scenarios + monthly calc)

Thanks — next step is simple: confirm the three items above and we’ll turn this into a one-page quote for procurement.

—
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@atlaslogistics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@atlaslogistics.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + request: spend band confirmation and procurement thresholds

Thanks Monica — appreciate the clear recap and the spreadsheet. Quick answers from procurement + ops below:  

1) Volume: 50M/month is a reasonable starting estimate for Q2; plan for +/- 30% depending on pilot results.
2) Procurement thresholds: Finance requires any recurring commitment > $25,000/month to go through an executive procurement review (2–3 week cadence). Anything <= $25k/month can be approved by our standard vendor onboarding (1 week).
3) Commit term: open to a 3-month pilot with a short-term commit and monthly billing. If we hit predictable usage, we’ll consider a 12-month reserved band.

Procurement attached our vendor guidance doc — it lists required PO fields and insurance limits. If Redwood can provide a one-page MA/quote that keeps monthly estimated spend under $25k for the pilot, procurement can greenlight faster.

Estimated target economics: our cost committee has a target ceiling of roughly $80–$120 per 1M tokens for high-quality LLM inference (this is a rough internal target; flexible if you show unit breakouts). For 50M tokens/month, that implies roughly $4k–$6k/month (math: 50 * $/1M).  

Attachment: Atlas_Procurement_Guidelines.pdf (procurement checklist)

Alex Johnson
Head of Product Ops
Atlas Logistics
alex.johnson@atlaslogistics.com | (617) 555-4433

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@atlaslogistics.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@atlaslogistics.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + request: spend band confirmation and procurement thresholds

Alex — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Two quick notes and a proposal so procurement has a clean artifact:  

1) Confirmation: we’ll size the pilot to keep estimated spend under the $25k/month expedited approval threshold. With your 50M/mo estimate, there’s comfortable headroom.

2) Pricing options (high-level):
   • Pilot (no long-term lock): usage-based at $120 / 1M tokens, invoiced monthly. Estimated cost @50M = $6,000/mo.
   • 3-month committed band (recommended): discounted to $80 / 1M tokens for a 3-month minimum; estimated cost @50M = $4,000/mo.
   • Reserved (12+ month): deeper discount available (example $60 / 1M) once we validate peak profiles and routing patterns.

Attached I’m sending a one-page MA/Quote (MA-Quote-2026.pdf) plus the same pricing scenarios spreadsheet. For procurement: we’ll include a single-line monthly estimate that keeps the pilot under $25k; we’ll also call out the commit option as a separate line item so you can choose at sign.  

Next steps I’ll take after your confirmation:
- Finalize one-page MA/Quote scoped to the pilot band.
- Ops (Sean) will prepare a short onboarding checklist and SSO/KMS notes for your security team.
- If procurement wants an invoice cadence or shortened PO wording, we’ll adapt.

Can you confirm by EOD Monday whether procurement prefers the pure-usage pilot or the 3-month commit so I can send the right quote?

Attachments: MA-Quote-2026.pdf; redwood-pricing-scenarios.xlsx

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

> 3) Commit term: open to a 3-month pilot with a short-term commit and monthly billing. If we hit predictable usage, we’ll consider a 12-month reserved band.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: Internal: prep MA/quote + onboarding checklist for Atlas pilot

Team — quick internal note following Alex’s confirmation. Actions I want us to take today so we can hit Monica’s EOD Monday ask:  

1) Monica: draft the 1-page MA/Quote for the 3-month committed band at $80 / 1M tokens (include an alternate line for the pure-usage pilot at $120 / 1M). Keep the monthly estimate single-line and explicit: "Estimated monthly invoice: $4,000 (50M tokens @ $80/1M)". 
2) Sean: assemble the onboarding checklist (SSO, KMS, IP allowlist, data retention notes) and a short security appendix we can attach to the MA. Add an internal note about how switching to reserved capacity (12m) will change net unit economics.
3) I’ll review and flag any margin exceptions or onboarding credits. We have latitude for a one-time onboarding credit up to $1,500 to keep the pilot under the $25k threshold if procurement pushes back.

Please drop drafts into the shared pricing doc (linked) and ping me when ready. I’ll loop Legal if procurement asks for vendor-specific PO language.

—
Lauren Bishop
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | (415) 555-0177
